grammar.topic: Dört temel zamanın tekrarı: Present Simple, Present Continuous, Past Simple, was / were
explainTr: Present Simple alışkanlık ve gerçekleri anlatır: I drink tea every morning. Present Continuous şu an olanı anlatır: I am drinking tea now. Past Simple bitmiş geçmişi anlatır: I drank tea yesterday. Was / were ise geçmişte olmak: I was tired.
Zaman ifadeleri yol gösterir: every day, usually, on Saturdays (Present Simple); now, right now, at the moment (Present Continuous); yesterday, last week, two days ago (Past Simple ve was/were).

Her cümlede iki kontrol yap: 1) Ne zaman? 2) Fiil doğru formda mı? Present Simple: he/she/it için -s. Present Continuous: am/is/are + fiil-ing. Past Simple: -ed veya düzensiz fiil; olumsuz ve soruda 'did' + yalın fiil.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'içiyorum' hem 'şu an içiyorum' hem 'her gün içiyorum' anlamında olabilir. İngilizcede ikisi ayrıdır: I drink (her gün), I am drinking (şu an). Geçmişte de 'içtim' tek ek ama İngilizcede drank veya did you drink?

reading.title: Hafsa's email to a friend
reading.text:
Subject: News from America

Dear Zeynep,

How are you? I hope you are well. I am writing from my kitchen. It is snowing outside, and I am drinking hot tea.

First, my news. Last month I visited a school and met the secretary, Mr. Brown. He is very kind. Now I am preparing to work as a substitute teacher. I study English every day, and I read short stories before bed.

Emre is fine. He plays soccer on Saturdays, and yesterday he made a new friend at school. I don't have much free time, but I am happy. I miss the roses of Isparta, and I often think about our garden.

Please reply soon and send me a photo.

Best regards,
Hafsa

options: She is writing an email and drinking tea.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'I am writing... I am drinking hot tea.'
Metin: 'I am preparing to work as a substitute teacher'.

script.text: Emre, I'm writing an email to my friend in Isparta. Can you help me?

script.speaker: Emre
script.text: Sure, Mom. What do you want to do?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I want to attach a photo. I took it yesterday in the park.

script.speaker: Emre
script.text: Okay. Click this button. Now choose the photo.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Oh, I see it. It's the picture with the snow.

script.speaker: Emre
script.text: Yes. What is the subject of the email?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Not yet. I'm writing about my school visit. I also wrote that you play soccer every Saturday.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: I'm only telling the good news. Now press send.

script.speaker: Emre

writing.promptTr: Bir arkadaşına kısa e-posta yaz (40-60 kelime). Şu an ne yaptığını, dün ne yaptığını ve her gün ne yaptığını yaz.
writing.promptEn: Write a short email to a friend. Use the present and the past.
writing.model: Dear Linda, How are you? I hope you are well. Yesterday I visited a school. It was great! Now I am studying English at home. The weather is cold, and I am drinking tea. Emre plays soccer every Saturday. I miss you. Please reply soon. Best regards, Hafsa
checklistTr: Şu an için am/is/are + fiil-ing, alışkanlık için yalın fiil (+s), dün için geçmiş fiil var mı?
Başta 'Dear ...' ve sonda 'Best regards' yazdın mı?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?
